items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He used to work with Basie. ... Cat that took Lester's place.

ctx.x: A little piano player. He works with Hawkins' little brother... What's that boy's name, a tenor player from Kansas City who got hurt...
He used to work with Basie.

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Adolphus was a big heavy-set boy who looked something like Mingus... all of them respected him. Pettiford would run around him like a little poor dog.

ctx.x: Yeah! You told me that. Adolphus was a big heavy-set boy who looked something like Mingus, and he carried himself... He'd come around and look at us like....
Judo expert. Judo expert. He had a black belt in Judo.
Yeah, all of them respected him. Pettiford would run around him like a little poor dog. He'd take him to dinner; that's his home(?).
